INTERFACEBENCH v1.6.0-rc.1

Design a panel, arrange its controls, document wiring, rehearse interaction and export fabrication files.

Open the workbench →

Put it on your server

Upload the entire extracted server ZIP to your /interfacebench/ directory, with index.html at that directory’s root. Preserve the js/, vendor/, fonts/ and other included files. No compile step or backend is required.

Open https://mbparks.com/interfacebench/. For local use, run python3 -m http.server 8000 inside this folder and visit localhost:8000. Opening index.html directly as a file is unsupported.

New in 1.6: distance and area measurement

Measure now has a highlighted active state, a crosshair cursor and a dedicated control strip. Click the first point for a numbered marker and live segment preview. Snap to geometry or grid, hold Shift to align, hold Alt for free placement, or enter exact point coordinates.

Choose Area, click around the outline, then click point 1, use Finish area, press Enter or double-click the final point. Read area and perimeter; Undo point or Backspace corrects the outline. New clears it and Done returns to selection. Measurements are temporary overlays. Area uses straight segments between points.

New in 1.5: precision placement

Select a part in Arrange. Under Precision placement, enter its distance from any panel border, or choose another component and apply an exact gap. Choose front face, mounting holes, rear body or mounting reference as the measured boundary.

Click an on-canvas dimension to edit it. With two parts selected, editing their centre distance moves the second part. Units, Undo and saved projects are supported. These are one-time placements, not locked constraints. Curved/irregular panels use outer bounds; check actual contour clearance.

New in 1.4.3

Rear labels use the same plain text styling as front labels. The rear-only outline and light fill have been removed.

New in 1.4.2: fabricate labels on either side

Select a component and use Label on Front and Label on Rear. Choose either, both, or neither. These two checkboxes save with the project and control the label artwork included in fabrication files.

The ZIP automatically includes separate front and rear-label SVG/PDF/PNG files for enabled formats. Rear artwork is positioned for the rear face up, with readable text. For an individual export, select Front or Rear above the canvas in Fabricate. Rear SVG/PNG contains only selected label paths. New parts default to front only.

New in 1.4

267 components, 14 categories, 255 new templates. Search by name, size or tags; filter by category and source; save favorites; inspect hole patterns and dimensions before placement. Custom parts support editable categories and tags.

Browse the complete component catalog →

265 generic definitions are planning geometry, not measured footprints. The two manufacturer-sourced definitions retain their own evidence and clearance assumptions.

New in 1.1–1.3

  • Opening and terminal tables; SVG curves and transforms.
  • Editable scale ticks and numeric/custom legends.
  • Sourced E-Switch parts, UNO R4 Minima and Nano Every presets.
  • Reusable library revisions with explicit instance updates.
  • PINNOTE, REFLEX and COPPERBENCH handoffs with conversion reports.

Find App handoffs under Connect or Fabricate. REFLEX exports device inventory and eligible pins, not rehearsal behavior. Copperbench imports a mounting template, not PCB routing.

Keep your work

Autosave uses this browser’s local storage. Use Backup for a portable JSON file. Updates do not intentionally clear projects; back up before replacing server files, then use Save & reload when an update is offered. Offline operation requires an initial HTTPS/localhost load.

Sources are documentation references. No telemetry or automatic external data requests are used.

Verification

91 automated checks and the companion native-parser checks pass. Generated PDF geometry was independently measured and rendered for review.

This remains a release candidate: real-browser interaction, responsive layout, actual IndexedDB and offline/update acceptance are unverified. Sourced dimensions include stated clearance assumptions; confirm your actual hardware before fabrication.

GPL-3.0-only. The repository package contains source, tests, detailed documentation and the identical deployable files.
